pages.text: A branch will not kill anything outright. It does not need to.$(br2)Heads do not enjoy being struck, and they enjoy it less each time. Falling onto something from a great height is, it turns out, also a way of striking it.

The giants leave something better than a branch: now and then a $(l)bone club$() - a great long bone, heavy at one end - from the megafauna, the giant hyena, a great cat or the giant baboon. It swings like a club, cracks skulls like one, and lasts far longer.
